charge_port.notes: Estimated: Wikipedia: CCS connector for DC fast charging; DC is tied to the SEL Premium/option trim, so cars without it (e.g. the 2016 SE) have a J1772 inlet only and 3.6 kW AC (trim split not sourced; OWNER: j1772 with dc 0 for those trims?).

supercharger_access.notes: VW Canada: the NACS DC adapter is officially for ID.4 and ID. Buzz and is not compatible with the e-Golf; Electrek (2025-11-12) lists only ID.4 and ID. Buzz. Applied to US and Canada.
